caption:
Links like ?p=123 look messy and say nothing. 🔗

WordPress dashboard > Settings > Permalinks > choose "Post name" > Save Changes.
On a live site: back up first, because old links can break.

Follow @techmendly for a new tech tip every day.

scenes.say: Why does my link say p equals one two three? Clean links take one setting.
scenes.shown: Why does my link say ?p=123? Clean links take one setting.

scenes.say: A plain link tells nobody anything. A post name link says what the page is about, and is easier to read and share.

scenes.title: Change your permalinks
scenes.say: Open Settings, then Permalinks. Pick Post name. Click Save Changes.

scenes.myth: It is safe to change on any site, anytime.
scenes.fact: On a live site, old links can break. Back up first.
scenes.say: Careful. On a live site, changing this can break old links. Back up first, and set it early on a new site.

scenes.title: Test a few old links
scenes.body: Open two or three pages to confirm they load.
scenes.say: Bonus tip. After saving, open a few old pages to confirm they still load.
